summary_en: Presents a fully non-contact laser-ultrasound tomography system for quantitative speed-of-sound mapping. An end-to-end convolutional neural network, trained on simulated time-of-flight matrices and speed-of-sound maps, reconstructs a 77 mm × 77 mm field in under 6 ms and is experimentally validated on heterogeneous tissue-mimicking phantoms. A two-stage time-of-flight picker improves travel-time estimation before CNN reconstruction.
